name: Toomi Chika
source:
Chika is in the Drama Club; she is good at preparing props for plays, but hates standing onstage herself. Unable to keep up with [url=/c98215]Yako[/url]'s spartan ways, she often attempts to run away or retaliate. It seems as if her ahoge is sensitive and actually functions like an antenna.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
